user.title: Add Financial Account
user.description: Create a new financial account to track your finances.

error.invalid_day_weekly: Day must be 1-7 for weekly frequency
error.invalid_day_monthly: Day must be 1-28 for monthly frequency
error.invalid_day_yearly: Day must be 1-28 for yearly frequency

get_accounts.name: Get Accounts
get_accounts.description: List all financial accounts with their current balance.

get_account.name: Get Account
get_account.description: Get full details of a specific account including transactions and recurring plans.

get_chart_data.name: Get Chart Data
get_chart_data.description: Get monthly income vs. expense chart data for an account.

export_csv.name: Export CSV
export_csv.description: Export all transactions for an account as CSV text.

add_transaction.name: Add Transaction
add_transaction.description: Record a new transaction (income or expense) to an account.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: Transaction amount. Positive for income, negative for expense.

update_transaction.name: Update Transaction
update_transaction.description: Modify an existing transaction's amount and/or note. Balance is adjusted by the difference.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: New amount. Balance is adjusted by the difference from the old amount.

delete_transaction.name: Delete Transaction
delete_transaction.description: Delete a transaction and revert its effect on the account balance.

add_plan.name: Add Recurring Plan
add_plan.description: Create a new recurring income/expense plan that auto-executes on schedule.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: Recurring amount. Positive for income, negative for expense.

frequency.name: Frequency
frequency.description: Recurrence: daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly.

day.name: Day
day.description: Day of recurrence. 1-28 for monthly/yearly, 1-7 (Mon-Sun) for weekly.

month.name: Month
month.description: Month (1-12) for yearly frequency only. Default 1.

active.name: Active
active.description: Whether the plan is active on creation. Default true.

update_plan.name: Update Recurring Plan
update_plan.description: Modify an existing recurring plan's settings.

frequency.name: Frequency
frequency.description: New frequency: daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly.

delete_plan.name: Delete Recurring Plan
delete_plan.description: Remove a recurring plan and its associated sensor entities.

add_account.name: Add Account
add_account.description: Create a new financial account with optional initial balance.

update_account.name: Update Account
update_account.description: Rename or update notes for an account.

name.name: Name
name.description: New account name. Cannot be empty or duplicate.

delete_account.name: Delete Account
delete_account.description: Delete an account and all its transactions, plans, and sensor entities.

adjust_balance.name: Adjust Balance
adjust_balance.description: Set an account's balance to a specific value. Creates an adjustment transaction for the difference.
